name: Quebec

items.label: Quebec Pension Plan (QPP)
items.note: 6.30% (5.30% base plus 1% first additional) of earnings above $3,500, up to $74,600: at most $4,479.30 in 2026.

items.label: Second additional QPP (QPP2)
items.note: 4% of earnings between $74,600 and $85,000: at most $416.

items.label: Employment Insurance (EI)
items.note: Quebec's reduced rate of 1.30% of insurable earnings up to $68,900 (at most $895.70), because QPIP pays parental benefits.

items.label: Contributions that earn a federal tax credit
items.note: Base QPP, EI and QPIP premiums.

items.label: Federal income tax
items.note: Basic federal tax less the 16.5% Quebec abatement.

items.label: Quebec Parental Insurance Plan (QPIP)
items.note: 0.430% of insurable earnings up to $103,000: at most $442.90.

items.label: Quebec taxable income
items.note: Salary less the deduction for workers (6%, up to $1,450) and the enhanced QPP contributions.

items.label: Quebec income tax
items.note: 14% to $54,345, 19% to $108,680, 24% to $132,245 and 25.75% above, less 14% of the $18,952 basic personal amount.

note: Quebec runs its own income tax, pension plan (QPP) and parental insurance (QPIP); federal tax is reduced by the 16.5% Quebec abatement.
